entries.headline: President says he directed the military not to proceed without two approvals
entries.summary: In a post on 11/23/26, President Trump said he directed the military not to proceed unless the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit and Iowa Governor-elect Rob Sand agree. The post gives no replacement date or time. The last reviewed Army notice lists 11/25/26; that is not confirmation the operation will go ahead.

entries.headline: Army moves the planned operation to 11/25/26
entries.summary: The Army rescheduled from 11/23/26 to 11/25/26. Its announcement did not give an exact time.

entries.headline: Federal agencies issue a joint statement
entries.summary: The Army published a statement with HHS and EPA describing their coordination and saying they would keep state and local officials and the public informed. The statement did not announce a new date.

entries.headline: Army postpones the operation to 11/23/26
entries.summary: The Army postponed the operation previously planned for 11/20/26. The 11/22/26 announcement superseded this notice.

entries.headline: Environmental groups ask the court to stay the EPA permit
entries.summary: Earthjustice said it filed an emergency motion in the Eighth Circuit on behalf of the Iowa Environmental Council and Sierra Club, asking the court to put the EPA permit on hold while it reviewed their challenge. This was a request by the groups, not a court ruling.

entries.headline: Army publishes its environmental assessment
entries.summary: The Army released its environmental assessment for the lead azide risk-mitigation project at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant.

entries.headline: Army updates the original public advisory
entries.summary: The updated advisory for the original 11/20/26 plan listed public contacts and identified a Reserve Center where residents could go. Later notices superseded this advisory.

entries.headline: EPA posts its emergency permit notice
entries.summary: EPA’s public notice said the agency had issued an emergency permit for storage and treatment at the plant, effective 11/13/26. The notice was informational and did not set the Army’s operating date.

entries.headline: Army announces the original 11/20/26 plan
entries.summary: The Army’s public advisory listed 11/20/26 at approximately noon. This date was superseded, and the time did not carry over to the new date.

entries.headline: Army reports on the Middletown open house
entries.summary: In its recap of the 10/15/26 open house, the Army said residents and local officials spoke with staff about the planned operation, environmental sampling and post-operation assessments.
